source: any repository with an existing generated course whose cited files have since changed
query: This onboarding course was generated a while ago. Is it still accurate, and can you bring it up to date?
expected_behavior: Runs the installed check-staleness helper against the published course and the current repository rather than regenerating from scratch
Reports which evidence records drifted and which claims rest on them, distinguishing drift from evidence that cannot be resolved at all
Re-reads each drifted file at the current revision and revises the affected claims, adjusting status where the new evidence no longer supports the old claim
Recomputes content_hash with the excerpt-hash helper rather than by hand
Leaves modules whose evidence still matches untouched
Updates provenance and generated_at, and rebuilds through the staging and manifest-ownership rules rather than overwriting the published course in place
Tells the user which claims changed and which held
